profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
I am a native iOS developer that has a passion for feature development. I love working on high impact and consumer facing features, and have been fortunate to find such opportunities building the fast account switching feature for Instagram, creating Outlook's advanced email filters at Microsoft, and launching numerous features to the Airbnb app.

My day-to-day involves working closely with other engineers, experience designers, and project managers to bring a product to life on the portable screen. I am a champion of technical quality, good UX design, and mentorship.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
User Clients
• User profile, account settings, sign up and login
• Personal info redesign

Reputation Clients
• List of listings redesign in 2023
• Host enforcement - listing issues

Host Growth
• Overhaul of listing creation and management flow
• Built host referral and host landing page, including an earnings estimation widget that drives host growth
• Built a tool for duplicating fields from an existing listing that significantly decreases the friction for volume hosts

Airbnb Plus
• Revamped Plus modules in the Search flow with high quality imagery to increase product distinction from traditional Airbnb
• Built Home Overview, an innovative tool that allows hosts to upload photos of their space before the onboarding journey as a way to assess fit early on and decrease drop-off
• Launched Fix It for Me, an incentive program for aspiring Plus hosts to complete fixes by a certain deadline for monetary rewards
• Built Plus Central, a hub for hosts to discover resources and track their progress in the Plus onboarding funnel
• Migrate language correction tool to service-oriented architecture for ease of maintenance
• Migrate Plus Manage Your Space backend endpoints to GraphQL

Market dynamics (MDX)
• Launched COVID-19 Extenuating circumstance coupon and travel credit programs in the guest cancellation flow
• Ran AB experiment on a modernized redesign of the guest refund summary page
• Rewrote cancellation by guest flow with improved architecture, modernized design, and modularization
• Built a mutual cancellation feature to allow guest and host to negotiate the refund amount

Host Loyalty
• Today Tab celebratory moments that help users commemorate their first booking and Superhost status achievement with custom Lottie animations
• Enhanced the Address Verification Feature by allowing hosts to use photo geotag to verify listing location

Enrichment
• Engineering mentorship program lead
• Founder and champion of Taiwanese cultural group

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Android - Creation Team. Worked on fast account switching, one of most highly requested features from users that manage multiple accounts. Positive impact on growth and user engagement.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for CIS 121 (Data Structures and Algorithms) for Spring and Fall 2014. Responsibilities include teaching weekly recitations for students, holding weekly office hours and exam review sessions, and grading assignments and exams.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern (SDE)
positions.description: Outlook Service, eXperience Engineering Team. Designed, implemented, and tested an Advanced Rules extension for the Outlook.com email service.

positions.title: Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description: Improved user experience with ASUS Gallery application by implementing Google Analytics tracking. Tested and debugged Android applications on the ASUS MeMO and Transformer Pads.
